run_get_stats: run the get_stats script with --root and --meta_path args to compute LibriLight dataset statistics
run_traverse_tree: run traverse_tree on a directory root to map audio filenames to their sample lengths
run_get_speakers: run get_speakers on a SPEAKERS.TXT file to parse speaker metadata into speaker objects
run_full_records: run full_records with speakers and filename-to-length mapping to build complete utterance records
run_get_histogram: run get_histogram on records with key and value lambdas to aggregate statistics by category
